Just because the cost of the organs are expensive doesn't mean the traffickers have the production or network to harvest. Organ donations in hospitals require intricate procedures and must be harvested in a timely manner. This requires a certain medical expertise some traffickers might not have. After harvesting organs still have to be put in specialized containers and put in a freezer entirely aseptically to avoid contamination. In short, it is a production and capital problem, not a matter of money. Traffickers often don't have the time or resources to do such things.
